# PP: same-path copy of vanilla's disaster, written by `uv run ppc disasters apply` (src/prosper_or_perish_constructor/disaster_breaking_point.py); do not edit.
sinicization_disaster = {

	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/disaster/sinicization_disaster.dds"

	monthly_spawn_chance = monthly_spawn_chance_very_low

	can_start = {
		pp_disaster_restart_allowed_trigger = { type = sinicization_disaster } # PP: breaking point

		has_any_active_disaster = no
		NOT = { has_variable = had_sinicization_disaster_variable }
		country_exists = c:CHI
		country_economical_base < {
			value = c:CHI.country_economical_base
			multiply = 0.6
		}
		societal_value:sinicized_vs_unsinicized <= -90
		NOT = { is_subject_or_below_of = c:CHI }
	}
	

	can_end = { # PP: breaking point: vanilla's way out, or the breaking point
		OR = {
			AND = {
		sinicization_disaster_end_trigger = yes
	}
			pp_disaster_breaking_point_trigger = { type = sinicization_disaster }
		}
	}
	modifier = {
		monthly_tribal_cohesion = -0.25
		monthly_legitimacy = -0.25
		monthly_republican_tradition = -0.25
		monthly_devotion = -0.25
		monthly_rebel_growth = 0.005
		global_estate_target_satisfaction = larger_permanent_target_satisfaction_penalty
	}
	
	on_start = {
		trigger_event_non_silently = sinicization_disaster.1
		set_variable = {
			name = china_side
			value = 0
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = sovereign_side
			value = 0
		}
	}
	on_end = { # PP: breaking point: past it without vanilla's way out, vanilla's end without the reward, then the blow
		if = {
			limit = {
				pp_disaster_breaking_point_trigger = { type = sinicization_disaster }
				NOT = { AND = {
		sinicization_disaster_end_trigger = yes
	} }
			}
			
			set_variable = { name = had_sinicization_disaster_variable years = 10 }
			remove_variable = sovereign_side
			remove_variable = china_side
			remove_variable = sinicization_attitude_event_variable
			remove_country_modifier = struggle_against_china_modifier
			remove_country_modifier = embracing_sinicization_modifier
			pp_disaster_breaking_point_effect = { type = sinicization_disaster }
		}
		else = {
		trigger_event_non_silently = sinicization_disaster.100
	}
		pp_disaster_escalation_cleanup_effect = { type = sinicization_disaster }
	}
	
	on_monthly = {
	
		random_list = {
			250 = { } 
			10 = { trigger_event_non_silently = sinicization_disaster.2 }
			10 = { trigger_event_non_silently = sinicization_disaster.3 }
			10 = { trigger_event_non_silently = sinicization_disaster.4 }
			10 = { trigger_event_non_silently = sinicization_disaster.5 }
			10 = { trigger_event_non_silently = sinicization_disaster.6 }
			10 = { trigger_event_non_silently = sinicization_disaster.7 }
			100 = { trigger_event_non_silently = sinicization_disaster.8 }
		} 
		# PP: breaking point
		pp_disaster_escalation_effect = { type = sinicization_disaster }
	}
}
